question: How many recitations are assigned to each bodily center?
premises: union of shiva and shakti is named
six hundred thousand recitations are stated
centers include eyes ears mouth and hamsa
inference: The verse assigns a six-hundred-thousand recitation count across named bodily centers.
uncertainties: exact distribution among centers is not fully explicit
plain_english: In the union of Shiva and Shakti, six hundred thousand recitations are said to apply to the eyes, going and coming, ear, hamsa, and mouth, O fair one.
